personalInfo.name: Muhammad Sohail
personalInfo.title: Full Stack Developer · Backend & AI-Integrated Applications

summary: I'm a full-stack developer based in Lahore, three years into building things across the JavaScript and TypeScript stack — React and Next.js on the front, Node, NestJS and FastAPI on the back, with SQL and NoSQL databases behind them. Lately my work has leaned toward automation: an AI-driven email pipeline on Azure OpenAI, a TypeScript trading bot wired into live market APIs over WebSocket, and SMS and payment flows that mostly run themselves. I like owning a feature the whole way — from the data model and system design through to deployment on Docker, AWS or Railway — and I care more about code that still makes sense in six months than code that demos well.

responsibilities: Developed SaaS applications and an automated trading bot using NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud Functions.
Built SMS auto-subscription, alerting, and messaging workflows using Twilio and MessageBird, including automated keyword-based flows (LOVE/UNSUB/STOP).
Integrated Stripe for subscription billing and one-time payments with webhook-driven status updates.
Deployed and maintained scalable backend services on Railway, using Airtable as a lightweight operational data layer.
Participated in system design discussions, sprint planning, and continuous refactoring of shared backend modules.
Led end-to-end feature development across React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, TypeScript, Prisma, and Sequelize for multiple client products.
Built authentication and authorization flows using Clerk, Passport.js, and Firebase Authentication across web applications.
Developed responsive, production-grade UIs using PrimeReact, Formik, Tailwind CSS, and Redux Toolkit.
Refactored legacy frontend and backend modules to improve code reusability, maintainability, and performance.
Implemented new features and resolved bugs across the front-end and back-end of multiple client projects.
Built REST APIs with Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, collaborating closely with frontend developers on integration.
Worked within an Agile scrum team using Git for version control and code review.
Built web scraping pipelines to extract and integrate third-party data from social media and external websites.

projects.title: Mail Flow Agent — AI Document Pipeline
projects.description: An end-to-end pipeline that reads unread Microsoft 365 mail, pulls structured property data out of the attachments with Azure OpenAI, and matches it against SQL Server — with a FastAPI admin panel to run and tune the whole thing.
achievements: Ingests unread Microsoft 365 emails with attachments, extracts structured property data with Azure OpenAI, and matches records in SQL Server via exact, fuzzy, and smart-matching strategies
Routes attachments into structured asset folders with inferred document classification (BS/IS/RR/TB) and quarterly checklist updates
Ships a FastAPI admin panel with CSRF protection, run dashboards, settings history, and secrets kept in environment config
Configurable rules (email filters, confidence thresholds, read-state handling) with structured run logging and DB health checks

projects.title: Dual-Market Arbitrage Bot (Kalshi + Polymarket)
projects.description: A TypeScript bot that watches Kalshi and Polymarket, finds the same outcome priced differently across the two, and checks whether the gap survives fees and gas before acting. Paper mode by default; live trading is opt-in and hedged.
achievements: Arbitrage detection and execution engine over Kalshi and Polymarket APIs using fee- and gas-aware net-edge calculations
Market normalization across two prediction platforms with dynamic execution intervals and structured Winston logging
Paper-trading simulator with P&L tracking plus a live hedged execution mode with built-in safety controls
Real-time WebSocket dashboard for cycle monitoring, trade history, and live status updates

projects.title: SMS-Auto — Community Weft
projects.description: A Next.js app for SMS-based community subscriptions — Stripe checkout and webhooks on one side, Bird.com inbound-SMS automation on the other, with Airtable holding the subscriber records.
achievements: Stripe checkout and webhook integration for subscriptions and one-time payments
Keyword-based subscriber flows (LOVE/UNSUB/STOP) with Airtable-backed persistence and tier management
Automated monthly care-message delivery and post-payment welcome sequences

projects.title: Growth Genie — Growth Platform
projects.description: A Next.js App Router product for AI-assisted idea validation and scoring, with dashboards, a knowledge base, and file uploads — backed by NestJS and FastAPI services and Redis-driven real-time status.
achievements: Next.js App Router client for AI-assisted idea validation, success scoring, dashboards, knowledge base, and Cloudinary uploads
Redis-backed real-time persona status (working/idle), broadcast to the UI over WebSocket
Contributed to NestJS backend APIs and FastAPI services powering execution and resume-submission workflows

projects.title: Order Pickup Dashboard — WynShop
projects.description: A dashboard that lets store managers and staff run customer pickup orders for a US eCommerce platform (WynShop, later acquired by Instacart), with real-time notifications and license-based age verification.
achievements: Dashboard for store managers and staff to manage customer pickup orders
Real-time order notifications and barcode-based age verification via US driver's licenses
Order tracking and Twilio SMS/email notifications for customers and staff, with MongoDB for scalable order data

projects.title: QualityShopMarketplace
projects.description: The frontend for a direct-to-consumer marketplace focused on healthy food and drink brands, pulling product data from .NET Core APIs and using the OpenAI API to classify health-conscious products.
achievements: Frontend for a DTC marketplace focused on healthy food and drink brands, integrating .NET Core backend APIs
Used the OpenAI API client-side to detect and classify health-conscious products
Surfaced filtered product data sourced from 2.5M+ Shopify stores, working with backend and data teams

projects.title: Contract Management System — Blitzy
projects.description: Stability and UX work on an AI-powered contract management system — debugging major UI issues and re-engineering the Vue/Quasar frontend to match updated .NET backend logic.
achievements: Improved stability and UX by debugging major UI and configuration issues
Re-engineered frontend components with Vue.js, Pinia, and Quasar to align with updated .NET backend logic
Contributed to performance optimization and UI consistency across a complex enterprise app

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A full-featured e-commerce site — Next.js frontend, NestJS backend, MySQL via Sequelize, with GraphQL for data fetching and the usual cart, auth, orders and payments.
achievements: Next.js frontend, NestJS backend, and MySQL via Sequelize ORM
Redux Toolkit for cart, user, and product state, with GraphQL for optimized data fetching
User authentication, order management, and payment processing

projects.title: Company Portfolio Website
projects.description: An SEO-focused company site — Next.js frontend over a Node/Express backend, with SQL Server via TypeORM for dynamic content and Passport.js for auth.
achievements: SEO-optimized Next.js frontend showcasing services, team, and projects over a Node/Express backend
TypeORM with SQL Server for dynamic content management and Passport.js for secure authentication
Contact/inquiry forms with React Hook Form, fully responsive with Tailwind CSS

projects.title: Pakistan Petrol Price App — Backend (300K+ downloads)
projects.description: The backend for a mobile app with 300K+ downloads — a LoopBack 4 API serving live petrol prices, kept current with Puppeteer scraping, plus Google Maps for nearby stations.
achievements: Secure, scalable LoopBack 4 API serving real-time petrol price data to a 300K+ download app
Puppeteer scraping to keep petrol price data current from external sources
Google Maps integration for nearby station discovery and fuel-efficiency calculations, with full user auth

projects.title: Pakistani Brands App — Aggregation Backend
projects.description: A backend that aggregates product data from 50+ Pakistani apparel sites with Puppeteer scraping, stores it in SQL Server, and pushes sale and new-product alerts via OneSignal.
achievements: Aggregates product data from 50+ Pakistani apparel websites via Puppeteer-based scraping
OneSignal push notifications for sales and new products, with SQL Server/Sequelize for storage
Secure LoopBack 4 + TypeScript API for user interactions and product listings

projects.title: Currency Converter App — Backend
projects.description: A Node/Express backend for real-time currency conversion across 20 countries, with daily gold-price updates for major Pakistani cities and OneSignal alerts on rate changes.
achievements: Real-time currency conversion across 20 countries via external exchange-rate APIs
Daily gold price updates for major Pakistani cities and OneSignal push notifications for rate changes
Secure user authentication with Passport.js for personalized services
